title: EngineeringResultContract
description: Output schema for deterministic engineering rules, condition scores, and functionality assessment (Kirti Antil). Distinguishes prototype decision-support metrics from certified structural engineering.

visual_condition_score.description: Quantified condition index calculated deterministically from visual defect coverage and severity.

water_functionality_score.description: Assessment of hydrological viability (aquifer recharge, siltation, inlet/outlet obstruction, catchment continuity).

restoration_priority_score.description: Action priority score synthesizing structural degradation urgency and hydrological revival potential.

root_cause_analysis.description: Deterministic rule deductions identifying underlying mechanisms of failure

engineering_disclaimer.description: Mandatory disclaimer stating that outputs represent non-invasive prototype assessments and cannot replace on-site structural/geotechnical audits.

scale_min.description: Minimum boundary of the scale (typically 0 or 0.0)

scale_max.description: Maximum boundary of the scale (typically 100 or 1.0)

method.description: Deterministic calculation rule or formula identifier

confidence.description: Confidence based on visual coverage and input quality

limitations.description: Explicit limitations and assumptions of this calculation
